mapper.insert: insert into chat_message (session_id, sender_type, content, msg_type, msg_status, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{senderType}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{msgStatus}, #{createTime})
insert into consultation_session (user_id, doctor_id, status, ai_summary, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{doctorId}, #{status}, #{aiSummary}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime});
insert into temp_audit (consultation_session_id, chat_message_id, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{chatMessageId}, NOW());
mapper.update:
update consultation_session
user_id = #{userId},
doctor_id = #{doctorId},
status = #{status},
ai_summary = #{aiSummary},
create_time = #{createTime},
update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id}

update chat_message
session_id = #{sessionId},
sender_type = #{senderType},
content = #{content},
msg_type = #{msgType},
msg_status = #{msgStatus},
doctor_summary = #{doctorSummary},
where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from consultation_session where user_id = #{userId} and doctor_id = #{doctorId}
mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.status, cs.ai_summary, cs.create_time, cs.doctor_id, doc.real_name AS doctorName, doc.avatar AS doctorAvatar, doc.title, dept.name AS deptName FROM consultation_session cs LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON cs.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON doc.dept_id = dept.id WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cs.update_time DESC
